final: WITH gains AS (SELECT c.country, cs.wins - COALESCE(LAG(cs.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, cs.constructorId ORDER BY r.round), 0) AS wins_gained FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(wins_gained) AS avg_wins FROM gains GROUP BY country), all_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM country_averages), above_all AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN all_mean AS am WHERE ca.avg_wins > am.mean_wins), above_all_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM above_all) SELECT AVG(a.avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(a.avg_wins - am.mean_wins) AS mean_excess_over_all, AVG(a.avg_wins - aam.mean_wins) AS mean_excess_over_above_all FROM above_all AS a CROSS JOIN all_mean AS am CROSS JOIN above_all_mean AS aam WHERE a.avg_wins > aam.mean_wins
